item.case_name: Mood or music piece, no dialogue
item.title: Quiet After the Rain

turns.text: Make a 10-second widescreen mood film: a lonely bus stop after rain, late at night. Melancholy but peaceful, with gentle movement. Completely silent, no dialogue or text.

item.tests: Tests whether a short silent film conveys a specified mood through imagery, lighting and movement rather than dialogue or explanatory text.

answer_sheet.Setting and mood: A lonely bus stop after rain at night; melancholy but peaceful.
answer_sheet.Visual style and camera movement: Gentle movement; other visual choices are your call.

must_haves: The delivered video lasts approximately 10 seconds and is landscape 16:9.
A lonely bus stop at night is clearly visible, with wet surfaces or puddles establishing recent rain.
Subdued lighting and unhurried pacing convey a melancholy, peaceful mood rather than suspense or excitement.
There is visible gentle movement, such as rippling reflections or a slow camera move, rather than a static image held for the entire clip.
The video is silent and contains no titles, captions or dialogue.

turns.text: I'd like you to make a mood film showing a lonely bus stop after rain, late at night. I've been wanting something that captures that quiet feeling when the day is finally over. What I have in mind is 10 seconds long and widescreen, in 16:9, with a mood that's melancholy but peaceful. Please keep the movement gentle. It should be completely silent, with no dialogue or text.

dialog.agent: Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?
dialog.why: It asks the user whether to include words and what exact wording to use.
dialog.user: No, there should be no words at all—no text or subtitles. It should also be completely silent, so the melancholy but peaceful feeling comes entirely from the visuals. Beyond keeping the movement gentle, the other visual choices are yours.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: A single continuous cinematic photorealistic wide shot of a lonely empty bus stop after rain, late at night. A modest glass shelter and empty bench sit beside a deserted street. A steady warm shelter lamp casts soft amber reflections across rain-darkened pavement, contrasting with cool blue nighttime shadows. Small puddles catch the light; occasional residual droplets fall gently from the shelter roof and make faint ripples. The rain has stopped. No people, no vehicles passing, no dramatic events. The camera makes an extremely slow, barely perceptible forward drift, maintaining the wide composition throughout. Restrained natural lighting, subtle film grain, quiet negative space, understated melancholy but peaceful relief, the feeling that the day is finally over. Gentle movement only, no cuts. Entirely silent. No dialogue, music, or sound effects. No words anywhere: no signs with lettering, no advertisements, no readable markings, no logos, no titles, no captions or subtitles.
